title: Exposition on Psalm 26
breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > Expositions on the Psalms (Augustine) > Psalm 26

paragraphs.text: 1. It may be attributed to David himself, not the Mediator, the Man Christ Jesus, but the whole Church now perfectly established in Christ.

2. <quote>Judge me, O Lord, for I have walked in my innocence</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 25:1}} . Judge me, O Lord, for, after the mercy which You first showed me, I have some desert of my innocence, the way whereof I have kept. <quote>And trusting in the Lord I shall not be moved.</quote> And yet not even so trusting in myself, but in the Lord, I shall abide in Him.

3. <quote>Prove me, O Lord, and try me</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 25:2}} . Lest, however, any of my secret sins should be hid from me, prove me, O Lord, and try me, making me known, not to You from whom nothing is hid, but to myself, and to men. <quote>Burn my reins and my heart.</quote> Apply a remedial purgation, as it were fire, to my pleasures and thoughts. <quote>For Your mercy is before my eyes</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 25:3}} . For, that I be not consumed by that fire, not my merits, but Your mercy, whereby You have brought me on to such a life, is before my eyes. <quote>And I have been pleasing in Your truth.</quote> And since my own falsehood has been displeasing to me, but Your truth pleasing, I have myself been pleasing also with it and in it.

4. <quote>I have not sat with the council of vanity</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 25:4}} . I have not chosen to give my heart to them who endeavour to provide, what is impossible, how they may be blessed in the enjoyment of things transitory. <quote>And I will not enter in with them that work wickedly.</quote> And since this is the very cause of all wickedness, therefore I will not have my conscience hid, with them that work wickedly.

5. <quote>I have hated the congregation of evil doers.</quote> But to arrive at this council of vanity, congregations of evil doers are formed, which I have hated. <quote>And I will not sit with the ungodly</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 25:5}} . And, therefore, with such a council, with the ungodly, I will not sit, that is, I will not place my consent. <quote>And I will not sit with the ungodly.</quote>

6. <quote>I will wash mine hands amid the innocent</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 25:6}} . I will make clean my works among the innocent: among the innocent will I wash mine hands, with which I shall embrace Your glorious gifts. <quote>And I will compass Your altar, O Lord.</quote>

7. <quote>That I may hear the voice of Your praise.</quote> That I may learn how to praise You. <quote>And that I may declare all Your wondrous works</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 25:7}} . And after I have learned, I may set forth all Your wondrous works.
8. <quote>O Lord, I have loved the beauty of Your house:</quote> of Your Church. <quote>And the place of the habitation of Your glory</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 25:8}} : where You dwell, and art glorified.

9. <quote>Destroy not my soul with the ungodly</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 25:9}} . Destroy not then, together with them that hate You, my soul, which has loved the beauty of Your house. <quote>And my life with the men of blood.</quote> And with them that hate their neighbour. For Your house is beautified with the two commandments.

10. <quote>In whose hands is wickedness.</quote> Destroy me not then with the ungodly and the men of blood, whose works are wicked. <quote>Their right hand is full of gifts</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 25:10}} . And that which was given them to obtain eternal salvation, they have converted into the receiving this world's gifts, <quote>supposing that godliness is a trade.</quote> {{BIBLE:1ti 6:5}}

11. <quote>But I have walked in mine innocence: deliver me, and have mercy on me</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 25:11}} . Let so great a price of my Lord's Blood avail for my complete deliverance: and in the dangers of this life let not Your mercy leave me.

12. <quote>My foot has stood in uprightness.</quote> My Love has not withdrawn from Your righteousness. <quote>In the Churches I will bless You, O Lord</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 25:12}} . I will not hide Your blessing, O Lord, from those whom You have called; for next to the love of You I join the love of my neighbour.

source_note: Source. Translated by an anonymous scholar. From Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, First Series, Vol. 8. Edited by Philip Schaff. (Buffalo, NY: Christian Literature Publishing Co., 1888.) Revised and edited for New Advent by Kevin Knight. <http://www.newadvent.org/fathers/1801026.htm>.
